1 /**
2  * Gate 5 / Wave 3 - the CONVERSATION's kickoff law: what the existing free-talk flow
3  * (engine/steward-conversation.mjs converse()) needs to synthesize, refine, show and
4  * confirm ONE complete kickoff_proposal_v0 bundle on the one store
5  * (<folder>/.ecgberht/kickoff/events.jsonl) without a form, a precondition prompt, or an
6  * execution leak. The flow stays the flow John already has - free talk, quiet synthesis,
7  * conversational refinement, one confirmation; what changes is what it synthesizes and
8  * where that lands.
9  *
10  * WHAT LIVES HERE - pure rules first, then the verbs the flow and the bridge call:
11  *
12  *   THE QUESTION CAP. At most KICKOFF_QUESTION_CAP (= 1) natural question per turn - the
13  *   North Star's letter. The seat may write more; the engine delivers one and reports the
14  *   rest as held, so a sparse opening never turns into a questionnaire.
15  *
16  *   ADAPTIVE DISCOVERY. One question per turn, with durable earlier answers.
17  *   No exchange count forces a plan. An explicitly requested compact provisional
18  *   proposal still uses the thin-bundle lane; ordinary discovery continues until
19  *   the user's intent is sufficiently clear.
20  *
21  *   THE SILENT BOOTSTRAP. A new effort has no Face, no session envelope, no budget. None
22  *   is a precondition for brainstorming and none is asked for: the Face is created ON
23  *   confirmation, the envelope is materialized INSIDE the confirmation receipt (Wave 2),
24  *   and until then the turn's spend rides the turn result. settleKickoffBootstrap names
25  *   what is missing and that nothing was prompted.
26  *
27  *   THE LANE. A stood-up campaign (a Face already on disk) keeps the pre-Gate-5
28  *   roadmap-ledger kickoff path the WH4 lane proves, BESIDE the store; a NEW effort (no
29  *   Face) writes only the store, so during proposal and refinement the execution-leak
30  *   sentinel sees nothing but .ecgberht/kickoff/ and the conversation log.
31  *
32  *   CONFIRM, SPOKEN. One hash-bound confirmation lands the receipt on the store (record
33  *   hash AND rendered-prose hash), then the Wave 4 projection writer re-derives the
34  *   read-model of record (.ecgberht/kickoff/projection.json + face.md) from that receipt,
35  *   and the confirmed bundle is mirrored into the pre-Gate-5 projections the chamber
36  *   paints today (roadmap plan entries, Face, Strip) - a mirror of the receipt, kept
37  *   beside the store until the Wave 5 precedence work retires it.
38  *
39  * Failure states carry a status code AND user-visible text; missing, empty, ambiguous and
40  * unknown are SEPARATE rows (kickoffConversationFailureTable). Stdlib only; nothing here
41  * imports child_process. Source is ASCII on purpose (the repo's mojibake sweep).
42  */
43

90 export const KICKOFF_TALK_TEXT = Object.freeze({
91   [KICKOFF_TALK_CODE.MISSING]:

93   [KICKOFF_TALK_CODE.EMPTY]:
94     'That came through empty. Say what the effort should produce and I will frame it. Nothing written.',

100 /**
101  * A conversational-input failure, shaped like the flow's other failures (say / text /
102  * user_text carry the same sentence; nothing written, nothing persisted).
103  *
104  * @param {string} code
105  * @param {object} [extra]
106  */
107 export function kickoffTalkFailure(code, extra = {}) {
108   const known = Object.hasOwn(KICKOFF_TALK_TEXT, code);
109   let text = known ? KICKOFF_TALK_TEXT[code] : KICKOFF_TEXT[KICKOFF_CODE.STATE_UNKNOWN];
110   const resolvedCode = known ? code : KICKOFF_CODE.STATE_UNKNOWN;
111   text = text.replace(/<turn>/g, String(extra.turn ?? '?'));
112   return {
113     ok: false,
114     code: resolvedCode,
115     status_code: resolvedCode,
116     error: extra.error ?? String(resolvedCode).toLowerCase(),
117     say: text,
118     text,
119     user_text: text,
120     lane: 'converse',
121     conversational: true,
122     proposal: null,
123     asks: [],
124     authoritative: false,
125     ledger_write: false,
126     dialogue_persisted: false,
127     ...extra,
128   };
129 }

131 /**
132  * Machine-readable failure-state table for the conversational surface. `missing`,
133  * `empty-but-valid`, `ambiguous` and `unknown` are SEPARATE rows; every row is a state
134  * converse() can actually end in (the unknown / store rows surface the store's own
135  * codes through the flow). Seat rows (unreachable, garbage, empty reply) stay with the
136  * flow's CONVERSE_TEXT, which already owns them.
137  *
138  * @returns {ReadonlyArray<{state: string, surface: string, status_code: string, user_text: string}>}
139  */
140 export function kickoffConversationFailureTable() {
141   const row = (state, code, text) => Object.freeze({
142     state,
143     surface: 'conversation',
144     status_code: code,
145     user_text: text,
146   });
147   return Object.freeze([
148     row('missing', KICKOFF_TALK_CODE.MISSING, KICKOFF_TALK_TEXT[KICKOFF_TALK_CODE.MISSING]),
149     row('empty-but-valid', KICKOFF_TALK_CODE.EMPTY, KICKOFF_TALK_TEXT[KICKOFF_TALK_CODE.EMPTY]),
150     row('ambiguous', KICKOFF_TALK_CODE.AMBIGUOUS, KICKOFF_TALK_TEXT[KICKOFF_TALK_CODE.AMBIGUOUS]),
151     row('unknown', KICKOFF_CODE.STATE_UNKNOWN, KICKOFF_TEXT[KICKOFF_CODE.STATE_UNKNOWN]),
152     row('backing-store-unreadable', KICKOFF_CODE.EVENTS_UNREADABLE, KICKOFF_TEXT[KICKOFF_CODE.EVENTS_UNREADABLE]),
153     row('backing-store-corrupt', KICKOFF_CODE.CORRUPT, KICKOFF_TEXT[KICKOFF_CODE.CORRUPT]),
154   ]);
155 }

159 /**
160  * Which turn this is, from the EPHEMERAL turns the caller holds (the browser page or the
161  * test): one more than the number of John's turns so far. Deterministic; no clock, no
162  * disk. A fresh session with an open draft never needs the count (the draft is shown).
163  *
164  * @param {Array<{role?: string}>} [turns]
165  * @returns {number}
166  */
167 export function kickoffTurnNumber(turns) {
168   const list = Array.isArray(turns) ? turns : [];
169   return 1 + list.filter((turn) => turn && String(turn.role ?? '').trim().toLowerCase() === 'john').length;
170 }

172 /**
173  * Deliver at most `cap` questions; report the rest as held. Pure.
174  *
175  * @param {Array<string>} [asks]
176  * @param {number} [cap]
177  * @returns {{asks: string[], held: string[], cap: number}}
178  */
179 export function capKickoffQuestions(asks, cap = KICKOFF_QUESTION_CAP) {
180   const list = (Array.isArray(asks) ? asks : [])
181     .map((ask) => String(ask ?? '').trim())
182     .filter(Boolean);
183   const bound = Number.isInteger(cap) && cap >= 0 ? cap : KICKOFF_QUESTION_CAP;
184   return { asks: list.slice(0, bound), held: list.slice(bound), cap: bound };
185 }

187 /**
188  * Does this turn request a THIN proposal? Only by explicit opt-in when the
189  * effort is still unframed: no kickoff confirmed, no proposal of any kind open, no
190  * confirmed roadmap step (an established campaign is never re-kicked-off by a count).
191  *
192  * @param {{turn_number: number, open_proposal?: object|null, confirmed_kickoff?: object|null,
193  *   step_count?: number}} input
194  * @returns {boolean}
195  */
196 export function kickoffNeedsThinProposal(input = {}) {
197   // A count of exchanges cannot establish shared understanding. The compact
198   // proposal lane remains available only when explicitly requested by its caller.
199   return input.explicit_thin_proposal === true
200     && input.open_proposal == null
201     && input.confirmed_kickoff == null
202     && !(Number(input.step_count) > 0);
203 }

205 /**
206  * The block the planning tier receives on a thin turn. Deliberately a SEPARATE block:

209 export const THIN_BUNDLE_INSTRUCTION = [
210   '--- EXPLICITLY REQUESTED THIN BUNDLE (turn <turn>) ---',
211   'The caller requested a compact provisional proposal. Preserve unresolved choices.',
212   'Return the SMALLEST honest kickoff bundle from what he actually said: one goal, one',
213   'component, one plan entry marked end_to_end_slice (first_slice_id names it),',
214   'integration null. Leave success_signals empty and done_when out unless he stated',
215   'them. Use only words he supplied or plainly implied; invent nothing to fill a field.',
216   'If one question would still help, it may ride in "asks" beside the bundle - never',
217   'instead of it.',
218 ].join('\n');

220 /** @param {number} turnNumber @returns {string} */
221 export function thinBundleInstruction(turnNumber) {
222   return THIN_BUNDLE_INSTRUCTION.replace(/<turn>/g, String(turnNumber));

225 /**
226  * Settle the session-open bootstrap SILENTLY. Nothing here prompts and nothing here
227  * writes: it names what a new effort lacks and where each absence is settled later.
228  * The turn's spend is deferred (rides the result) exactly when there is no session
229  * envelope at all; an envelope that exists keeps its own law (debit, stop at the cap).
230  *
231  * @param {{face?: object|null, envelope_state?: object|null}} [input]
232  */
233 export function settleKickoffBootstrap(input = {}) {
234   const missing = [];
235   if (input.face == null) missing.push('face');
236   const env = input.envelope_state;
237   const envelopeAbsent = env == null || env.empty === true;
238   if (envelopeAbsent) missing.push('envelope', 'budget');
239   else if (env.live !== true) missing.push('budget');
240   return Object.freeze({
241     silent: true,
242     prompted: false,
243     missing: Object.freeze(missing),
244     envelope_absent: envelopeAbsent,
245     spend_deferred: envelopeAbsent,
246     face_created_on: KICKOFF_FACE_CREATED_ON,
247     envelope_materialized_in: KICKOFF_ENVELOPE_MATERIALIZED_IN,
248   });
249 }
250 
251 /**
252  * The pre-Gate-5 lane: a stood-up campaign (a parsed Face on disk) keeps the roadmap-ledger
253  * kickoff path beside the store. A NEW effort has no Face by definition (it is created on
254  * confirmation) and writes only the store.
255  *
256  * @param {{narrative?: object|null}} [context] a loadStewardContext() result
257  * @returns {boolean}
258  */
259 export function usesLegacyRoadmapLane(context) {
260   return context?.narrative != null;
261 }

263 // -- the verbs -----------------------------------------------------------------------
264 
265 /**
266  * Open the WHOLE bundle the seat authored on the store: v1 on an empty lineage, a
267  * superseding proposal at the same version before a confirmation, v(n+1) after one -
268  * the Wave 2 verbs, chosen by the lineage's state. The host asserts the seat lineage.
269  *
270  * @param {string} projectPath
271  * @param {{bundle: object, seat_family?: string, driver?: string, client_event_id?: string,
272  *   source_turn_id?: string|null, source_turn_at?: string|null, at?: string, timeoutMs?: number}} opts
273  */
274 export function openKickoffBundle(projectPath, opts = {}) {
275   const lineage = readKickoffLineage(projectPath);
276   if (!lineage.ok) return lineage;
277   const verb = lineage.state === KICKOFF_STATE.EMPTY ? openKickoffProposal : reproposeKickoff;
278 
279   // Repeat-idempotence, by CONTENT. The record hash carries its source turn, so the same
280   // bundle re-authored on a later turn compiles to a new hash and would supersede itself
281   // on the store. Compile the candidate under the OPEN record's own source turn: when it
282   // IS that record, re-open under that source turn and the store's own idempotent branch
283   // answers with the open proposal - the same bundle again IS the open proposal, and
284   // nothing is appended. Anything else (new content, a new seat) stays a real re-proposal.
285   let sourceTurnId = opts.source_turn_id ?? null;
286   let sourceTurnAt = opts.source_turn_at;
287   const openTurnId = lineage.open?.source_turn?.client_event_id;
288   if (openTurnId) {
289     const candidate = compileKickoffProposal(opts.bundle, {
290       seat_family: opts.seat_family,
291       driver: opts.driver,
292       version: lineage.open.version,
293       prior_confirmed_hash: lineage.open.prior_confirmed_hash ?? null,
294       source_turn_id: openTurnId,
295       source_turn_at: lineage.open.source_turn?.at,
296     });
297     if (candidate.ok && candidate.proposal_hash === lineage.open.proposal_hash) {
298       sourceTurnId = openTurnId;
299       sourceTurnAt = lineage.open.source_turn?.at;
300     }
301   }
302 
303   const opened = verb(projectPath, {
304     proposal: opts.bundle,
305     seat_family: opts.seat_family,
306     driver: opts.driver,
307     client_event_id: opts.client_event_id,
308     source_turn_id: sourceTurnId,
309     source_turn_at: sourceTurnAt,
310     at: opts.at,
311     timeoutMs: opts.timeoutMs,
312   });
313   if (!opened.ok) return opened;
314   return {
315     ...opened,
316     lineage_state_before: lineage.state,
317     confirmed_version_before: lineage.confirmed?.version ?? null,
318   };
319 }
320 
321 /** The bundle CONTENT of a stored record - what the seat authored, nothing of the envelope. */
322 function bundleContentOf(record) {
323   return {
324     goal: record.goal,
325     success_signals: [...(record.success_signals ?? [])],
326     work_product: {
327       id: record.work_product.id,
328       name: record.work_product.name,
329       components: (record.work_product.components ?? []).map((component) => ({ ...component })),
330     },
331     integration: record.integration == null
332       ? null
333       : {
334         summary: record.integration.summary,
335         relationships: (record.integration.relationships ?? []).map((relationship) => ({
336           kind: relationship.kind,
337           component_ids: [...(relationship.component_ids ?? [])],
338           description: relationship.description,
339         })),
340         proof: { ...record.integration.proof },
341       },
342     plan_entries: (record.plan_entries ?? []).map((entry) => ({
343       ...entry,
344       component_ids: [...(entry.component_ids ?? [])],
345     })),
346     first_slice_id: record.first_slice_id,
347   };
348 }
349 
350 /**
351  * Mirror a store-confirmed bundle into the pre-Gate-5 projections (roadmap plan entries,
352  * Face, Strip) through the existing roadmap verbs. A mirror, never a source of truth: the
353  * receipt on the store is what was confirmed. When the roadmap already carries the same
354  * open hash (the legacy lane wrote both), only the confirm is appended; when it carries a
355  * different lineage, the mirror confirms the roadmap's own hash and says `diverged`.
356  */
357 function mirrorConfirmedKickoffToRoadmap(root, record, opts = {}) {
358   const shown = showKickoff(root);
359   if (!shown.ok) {
360     return { ok: false, written: false, code: shown.code, error: shown.error, detail: shown };
361   }
362   if (shown.confirmed?.proposal_hash === record.proposal_hash) {
363     return {
364       ok: true,
365       written: false,
366       already: true,
367       diverged: false,
368       roadmap_proposal_hash: record.proposal_hash,
369       plan_entries_written: 0,
370       projection: null,
371     };
372   }
373   let roadmapHash = shown.open?.proposal_hash === record.proposal_hash ? record.proposal_hash : null;
374   if (!roadmapHash) {
375     // The roadmap lacks this bundle (a new effort wrote only the store): append it there
376     // with the record's own seat lineage and source turn, so a fresh roadmap re-derives
377     // the same hash.
378     const proposed = proposeKickoff(root, {
379       proposal: bundleContentOf(record),
380       seat_family: record.provenance?.seat_family,
381       driver: record.provenance?.driver,
382       source_turn_id: record.source_turn?.client_event_id ?? '',
383       source_turn_at: record.source_turn?.at ?? '',
384       client_event_id: `${opts.client_event_id}#mirror-propose`,
385       project_id: opts.project_id,
386       at: opts.at,
387     });
388     if (!proposed.ok) {
389       return { ok: false, written: false, code: proposed.code, error: proposed.error, detail: proposed };
390     }
391     roadmapHash = proposed.proposal_hash;
392   }
393   const confirmed = confirmKickoff(root, {
394     proposal_hash: roadmapHash,
395     who: opts.who,
396     client_event_id: opts.client_event_id,
397     project_id: opts.project_id,
398     at: opts.at,
399   });
400   if (!confirmed.ok) {
401     return { ok: false, written: false, code: confirmed.code, error: confirmed.error, detail: confirmed };
402   }
403   return {
404     ok: true,
405     written: confirmed.ledger_write === true,
406     already: confirmed.idempotent === true,
407     diverged: roadmapHash !== record.proposal_hash,
408     roadmap_proposal_hash: roadmapHash,
409     plan_entries_written: confirmed.plan_entries_written ?? 0,
410     projection: confirmed.projection ?? null,
411     projection_pending: confirmed.projection_pending === true,
412   };
413 }
414 
415 /**
416  * THE SPOKEN CONFIRMATION - the bridge's `--kickoff-confirm` and the chamber's one "yes".
417  *
418  * The record hash names a proposal on the store: the receipt is appended there, bound to
419  * BOTH hashes John saw. When the caller did not send the rendered-prose hash (the pre-Gate-5
420  * chamber sends the record hash alone), it is resolved from the stored record whose hash
421  * matched - the fidelity law already pins that prose to that record - and the result says
422  * so by name. A hash the store does not know falls through to the roadmap-only lane (a
423  * project whose kickoff pre-dates the store). Then the confirmed bundle is mirrored into
424  * the pre-Gate-5 projections (roadmap plan entries, Face, Strip) unless `mirror: false`.
425  *
426  * Idempotent by content (a repeated matching confirmation appends nothing anywhere) and
427  * stale-safe (a superseded hash refuses with the store's named row and writes nothing).
428  *
429  * @param {string} projectPath
430  * @param {{who: string|object, proposal_hash: string, rendered_prose_hash?: string,
431  *   prior_confirmed_hash?: string|null, client_event_id?: string, project_id?: string|null,
432  *   at?: string, mirror?: boolean, timeoutMs?: number}} opts
433  */
434 export function confirmKickoffSpoken(projectPath, opts = {}) {
435   const root = path.resolve(projectPath);
436   const providedHash = String(opts.proposal_hash ?? '').trim();
437   const lineage = readKickoffLineage(root);
438   if (!lineage.ok) return { ...lineage, lane: 'store', mirror: null };
439 
440   const named = lineage.proposals.find((proposal) => proposal.proposal_hash === providedHash) ?? null;
441   if (!named) {
442     const legacy = confirmKickoff(root, {
443       proposal_hash: providedHash,
444       prior_confirmed_hash: opts.prior_confirmed_hash,
445       who: opts.who,
446       client_event_id: opts.client_event_id,
447       project_id: opts.project_id,
448       at: opts.at,
449     });
450     return { ...legacy, lane: 'roadmap', store_state: lineage.state, mirror: null };
451   }
452 
453   let proseHash = String(opts.rendered_prose_hash ?? '').trim();
454   const resolved = !proseHash;
455   if (resolved) proseHash = named.rendered_prose_hash;
456   const receipt = confirmKickoffProposal(root, {
457     who: opts.who,
458     proposal_hash: providedHash,
459     rendered_prose_hash: proseHash,
460     client_event_id: opts.client_event_id,
461     at: opts.at,
462     timeoutMs: opts.timeoutMs,
463   });
464   if (!receipt.ok) return { ...receipt, lane: 'store', mirror: null };
465 
466   // The Wave 4 writer: the Face and projection.json are re-derived from the receipt at
467   // every matching confirmation - byte-identical on a repeat, so double-confirm is
468   // harmless downstream. A refused receipt above never reaches this line, which is what
469   // keeps the Face absent on open, rejected, and stale paths.
470   const storeProjection = writeKickoffProjection(root, { timeoutMs: opts.timeoutMs });
471 
472   const mirror = opts.mirror === false
473     ? null
474     : mirrorConfirmedKickoffToRoadmap(root, receipt.proposal, {
475       who: opts.who,
476       client_event_id: receipt.receipt?.client_event_id ?? opts.client_event_id,
477       project_id: opts.project_id,
478       at: opts.at,
479     });
480   return {
481     ...receipt,
482     lane: 'store',
483     rendered_prose_hash_resolved_from_store: resolved,
484     mirror,
485     face_created_on: KICKOFF_FACE_CREATED_ON,
486     store_projection: storeProjection,
487     projection_written: storeProjection.ok === true && storeProjection.projection_written === true,
488     face_written: storeProjection.ok === true && storeProjection.face_written === true,
489     projection: mirror?.projection ?? null,
490     projection_pending: mirror ? mirror.ok !== true || mirror.projection_pending === true : false,
491     plan_entries_written: mirror?.plan_entries_written ?? 0,
492   };
493 }
494 
495 /** A record as the chamber shows it: the prose John reads and the two hashes he confirms. */
496 function shownRecord(record) {
497   if (!record) return null;
498   return {
499     version: record.version,
500     proposal_id: record.proposal_id,
501     proposal_hash: record.proposal_hash,
502     rendered_prose: record.rendered_prose,
503     rendered_prose_hash: record.rendered_prose_hash,
504     prior_confirmed_hash: record.prior_confirmed_hash ?? null,
505     goal: record.goal,
506     supersedes: record.supersedes ?? null,
507     appended_at: record.appended_at ?? null,
508   };
509 }
510 
511 /**
512  * Read-only: what a session paints from the store alone - the confirmed kickoff and any
513  * open (draft, not applied) proposal, each with its prose and hashes, plus the pre-Gate-5
514  * roadmap view beside it for the chamber that still reads it.
515  *
516  * @param {string} projectPath
517  */
518 export function showKickoffSpoken(projectPath) {
519   const root = path.resolve(projectPath);
520   const lineage = readKickoffLineage(root);
521   if (!lineage.ok) return lineage;
522   const legacy = showKickoff(root);
523   return {
524     ok: true,
525     project_path: root,
526     state: lineage.state,
527     status_code: lineage.status_code,
528     user_text: lineage.user_text,
529     authoritative: lineage.authoritative,
530     confirmed: shownRecord(lineage.confirmed),
531     open: shownRecord(lineage.open),
532     receipt: lineage.receipt
533       ? { receipt_hash: lineage.receipt.receipt_hash, who: lineage.receipt.who, at: lineage.receipt.at }
534       : null,
535     receipt_count: lineage.receipt_count,
536     proposal_count: lineage.proposal_count,
537     superseded: lineage.superseded,
538     next_version: lineage.next_version,
539     legacy_roadmap: legacy.ok
540       ? {
541         ok: true,
542         confirmed_hash: legacy.confirmed?.proposal_hash ?? null,
543         open_hash: legacy.open?.proposal_hash ?? null,
544         roadmap_exists: legacy.roadmap_exists === true,
545       }
546       : { ok: false, code: legacy.code, error: legacy.error },
547   };
548 }
